name: gaming-engineer-kb
purpose: Shared knowledge library for 3D model creation, 3D world creation, and 3D animation, consumed by Seele (Blender bridge), Hermes workers (kanban tasks), and opencode.
consumption: Locate topic by tag, load core doc, apply numbered pipeline, respect QA gates, use data/*.json presets verbatim.

topics.title: 3D Model Creation
topics.summary: AI mesh generation to game-ready asset: cleanup, retopology, UV, PBR rebake, LOD chain, QA gates.

topics.title: 3D World Creation
topics.summary: Tile-based world management, cell streaming with hysteresis, terrain heightmap/GPU pipelines, deterministic scattering, modular kit rules.

topics.title: 3D Model Animation
topics.summary: Skeleton conventions, LBS math, 4-influence rule, bind-pose discipline, morph target memory, facial layering, retargeting, glTF animation export.

topics.title: PBR Materials
topics.summary: Metallic-roughness map specs, sRGB vs linear, full material presets incl. Seele styles, UV density rules.

topics.title: glTF/GLB Pipeline
topics.summary: Draco + KTX2 parameters, gltf-transform batch ops, engine support matrix, Blender export settings, validation gates.

topics.title: Blender Headless Operations
topics.summary: Headless bpy patterns, Seele bridge reuse, batch LOD/material generation, seed determinism, error handling.

topics.title: Optimization Budgets
topics.summary: Numeric budgets per asset tier, world block, and platform.

engine.note: Maps KB rules onto Twilight engine stubs (asset/frame_graph/shader) and blender_asset_loader.

binding_rules: 1 Blender unit = 1 meter; apply transforms before export
GLB + Draco + KTX2 for runtime delivery; uncompressed sources in version control
Every generative batch uses an explicit seed
Engine code changes land in twilight-elysium first, then vendor outward
